item.ladisdirewolves.direwolf_food.descr: Feed it to a regular wolf to turn it into a ferocious Direwolf. Not recommended for consumption.
Used to train a Direwolf. Gives points to level up its stats.
item.ladisdirewolves.whistle.description: Opens the Direwolf training interface to improve its stats.
gui.ladisdirewolves.effect.vitality: Heart per level. Heal by feeding

advancements.ladisdirewolves.goodest_boy: Give your Direwolf its very first training treat.
advancements.ladisdirewolves.dog_waltz.d: Craft a whistle to command and train your companion.

fml.menu.mods.info.description.ladisdire: Ladis'' Direwolves is a mod that transforms ordinary wolves into loyal, powerful, and upgradable companions. Forget about pets that quickly perish in battle — now your wolf will become a true combat partner and a reliable mount!
